name: Bilingual startup and original gameplay
description: Switch languages, load the engine and play the opening level.
steps: Switch to English if needed, then toggle to Hebrew and reload; verify Hebrew RTL is retained. Toggle back to English.
Click Load game, wait for Play now, and click it. Use Escape to skip the intro, then Enter with a short hold through Start Game, one player, character selection and briefings.
Hold ArrowRight, Z and X to move, fire and jump in the original level.
expected: Language selection survives reload and gameplay visibly responds without an engine startup error.

name: Mobile landscape touch play
description: Use the independent movement and action controls on a phone.
steps: Load and start the game. Use OK to navigate the original menus and choose a character.
Use a landscape phone viewport. Verify the directional pad and action buttons flank the game without covering it.
Hold right on the pad while holding Fire, slide to another direction, use Jump, then release all touches.
Leave and return to the tab.
expected: Movement and action controls fit the phone viewport, can be held together, and do not remain stuck after release or tab switching.

name: Pause, help and game-mode recovery
description: Pause and resume the current run and open accessible instructions.
steps: Load and start a one-player game through the original menus.
Click Pause and confirm the original pause menu stays visible. Click Resume to continue.
Open How to play, read the controls, then close the dialog to continue the same run.
Enter Game mode and use Exit game mode to return.
expected: The pause menu persists until resumed, help opens and closes, and game mode can be exited without restarting the run.

name: Cancel restart to protect the current run
description: Reject an accidental restart, then confirm an intentional reset.
steps: Load and start a game, then open How to play.
Choose Restart game and cancel its confirmation. Close help and verify the run remains available.
Open help again, choose Restart game, and accept its confirmation.
Verify Source & development points to shirel11/blip-blop-web and no prior repository is advertised.
expected: Cancelling keeps the run; confirming returns to the initial load screen. The page identifies the new public source project.
